reviews.title: Ads suck
reviews.text: I love your puzzles so much and I do them every day!  But your ads are so messed up.  And,  I was playing word scramble and I got an ad every time I tried to play a word.  That’s annoying!

reviews.title: Subscribing got me nowhere.
reviews.text:
I subscribed, but had no access to unlimited puzzles.

I got charged for nothing. Hopefully, this gets fixed.

reviews.title: Original
reviews.text: I'm glad you went back to original format

reviews.title: Puzzles Don’t Open
reviews.text: Waste of time and aggregation when puzzles won’t open.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: It won’t recognize my login after  numerous attempts and work arounds.  Even as a subscriber I am still prompted that I need to subscribe to access beyond the 2 free crosswords.  With years of stats that I’d like to keep, forced to find something that works.

reviews.title: App Change
reviews.text: Glad you went back to the previous version

reviews.title: Ads
reviews.text: I have paid an annual fee to plan without ads.  But the ads continue to roll in between each game.  I have reported in the past without results. Payment was for yearly amount.  Feel like I am stuck seeing ads. USA needs to stop tricking customers.

reviews.title: Changes
reviews.text:
UPDATE: ITS BACK! Thank you for listening to your players and changing it back!

The changes they just made to a different format suck! Please please please change it back. Went from 5 stars to 1 star real fast.

reviews.title: New layout
reviews.text: Update: have they really not fixed this issue yet? I canceled my subscription 2 weeks ago due to the horrendous new update, and I keep coming back, assuming the developers would have realized by now and read one of the many, many recent reviews, but apparently not!

reviews.title: Update is awful
reviews.text: The crossword interface is now broken. It’s not at all as user friendly as it was before this ugly update. Switch it back please

reviews.title: Terrible app design
reviews.text: The latest app redesign is awful. You have to pan and pinch and zoom to see the crossword, and the keyboard overlaps it. The old version the keyboard stopped under the crossword. Additionally, you can no longer jump to the next clue from the keyboard, you can only do it from the top of the crossword. This is so bad I’m not convinced it wasn’t vibe coded by a chimpanzee. I will be canceling my subscription.

reviews.title: Woof
reviews.text: I never leave reviews but they ruined something good here. Know your audience, know who you are appealing too. No need for the crazy layout and shoving ads down our throats ad nauseam. Simple is best sometimes. Remember that

reviews.title: new update makes everything unplayable
reviews.text: I will 100% be cancelling my subscription since it’s basically unusable now.

reviews.title: New design is awful
reviews.text: Unplayable. How this new design got approved is astonishing.

reviews.title: Ruined
reviews.text: Completely unplayable on iPad as of the latest update. When you hit "Start playing," you get nothing. Reinstalled and same thing happens. Didn't anyone test this before release?

reviews.title: New Format
reviews.text: I had been doing crosswords on my iPhone for a long time and loved it. Am really unhappy with the new format so I cancelled my subscription. Hoping they go back to the previous one. If so, I will resubscribe.

reviews.title: Update is terrible
reviews.text: This new update to the app has made it unusable. I was playing regularly and now I’ve deleted the app.

reviews.title: New design is AWFUL
reviews.text:
Who designed this awful new version? It’s not user friendly at all. When you try to type in letters for the crossword, you have to jump up to the top of the screen to move to the next space. I’m bummed my year renewal kicked in last month. Had I known this was the design I would have canceled it beforehand. 

Please change it back. I will not be renewing next year if it’s still this awful. 

I am old and can revert back to paper crosswords for the next 50 years of my life.

reviews.title: Unplayable
reviews.text: The new update is terrible! I’ve been a subscriber for years, but now I plan to cancel.  The puzzle doesn’t even fit on the screen. Terrible layout

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: I find this the most difficult crossword. It can’t be opened most of the time. Please bring back the previous crossword format.

reviews.title: Worst Ever
reviews.text: It blows my mind that a company can put out something this deficient. It shows a total lack of integrity and concern for the user. This app is an absolute joke! Very difficult to navigate, very difficult to get to the puzzle. When you do get to the puzzle, they’ve moved the clue to the top which is not a natural place to look. They don’t have buttons to navigate to the next word. If you hit the space bar it’ll change either up or down, but it doesn’t take you to the next word. This app is so lacking. It is just disgusts me. You would think they would have some quality control and serious testing before releasing a new app.  Supposedly they’re aware of the problems and they’re going to come out with a classic version that corrects the problems. I’ll be holding my breath.

reviews.title: Update
reviews.text: The latest update is awful. I hate it. I was a subscriber but am going to cancel my subscription. Give us the option to revert back to the old layout at the very least.

reviews.title: Unplayable
reviews.text: Revert back asap!

reviews.title: New update is terrible
reviews.text: The new update is terrible. Please revert.

reviews.title: Totally Ruined
reviews.text: New update has made the app impossible to use in flight.

reviews.title: So much worse
reviews.text: The look of the new app is so much worse. The field of the puzzle is so much smaller. I understand that the app is free because you have to look at ads, but most free games wait until you finish a game to throw you the ads. This one has shortened the window of the game to make room for ads right on the screen while you’re playing the game. They’ve changed the button to start playing. What was wrong with the old Crossword?

reviews.title: New format is terrible
reviews.text: You have to scroll through countless ads to access the crossword and then you can’t even see the clue and space at the same time when you get to the bottom half of the puzzle.

reviews.title: Bring back the old app
reviews.text: It was so much easier to use and enjoy before the update. Now games don’t fit on the screen and it takes longer to access all of them. I’m so disappointed.

reviews.title: Hate the new interface
reviews.text: I loved this app prior to recent updates. I can’t even view the full puzzle on my phone. Just not a fan and planning to cancel my subscription.

reviews.title: Latest update
reviews.text: This last update makes it difficult to use because it is no longer formatted to fit the screen without scrolling up and down to see the blanks or to see the clue when you get to the bottom of the puzzle. It’s really a pain.

reviews.title: Update
reviews.text: The new update stinks.  I used to play everyday and now the puzzles time out and some don’t even appear.  It’s not reliable. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: New version sucks.
reviews.text: Change it back to old layout.

reviews.title: New design 👎
reviews.text: The update is horrible! I know it won’t hurt you but I will be no longer be playing

reviews.title: Update has ruined the app
reviews.text: Please undo this update, it’s so bad and so much worse that it’s hard to believe the update isn’t a joke. The crossword pre-update was such a nice, simple, easy to navigate, relaxing puzzle. The redesign is the exact opposite. Cancelling my subscription because the games are unplayable now.

reviews.title: Was fine, now impossible to use
reviews.text: The update ruined what was once a good app. I don’t understand why they thought this was an acceptable release, unless they’re intentionally making it miserable to force you to pay for the premium app. Terrible changes, very clunky, crossword doesn’t fit on one screen and you have to scroll down to read the clues then scroll up to type.

reviews.title: Unplayable
reviews.text: So incredibly difficult to smoothly play a puzzle. Scrolling up, scrolling down, you can’t hit next with most scrolling down again. I will not continue to play until this changes. Awful.

reviews.title: Please revert!
reviews.text: The new version is awful!  I can’t see the whole puzzle, it’s hard to navigate, it’s harder to advance to the next clue, it’s harder to read and interact with the puzzle itself.  If they don’t revert back I’ll cancel my subscription.

reviews.title: New update is awful
reviews.text: The new update is an atrocity. Not user-friendly at all. The window to play the games is smaller, convenient buttons have moved away from the keyboard. Fire whoever signed off on this.

reviews.title: New update… Not good
reviews.text: The old UI was much better. The black / neon overhaul is overwhelming and feels incongruent with the types of games being offered. The typeface on the daily crossword is too large for the phone screen, making it so you have to scroll back and forth to see what you’re typing and what the hint is. Removing the feature that immediately moves you to the next word when you finish one was a bad call. Overall, the old interface and features were way better. I understand that the intention was probably to shine equal amount of lights on the other games, but this wasn’t the way to do that. I actually am less likely to play *any* of the games with this update. Love USA Today’s daily crossword, but I probably won’t be playing it until the UI is overhauled again.

reviews.title: New Update Is Awful
reviews.text: The new interface for this app is horrible to use. Puzzles used to be easy to play and navigate. I couldn’t even finish a crossword simply because of the frustration from trying to navigate the clues. I’ll pass on this for now. Canceling my subscription pronto.

reviews.title: Redesign failure
reviews.text: The latest redesign has completely ruined the experience. You need to scroll to see clues in the lower areas of the puzzle. Wish they would revert all the design. They managed to screw up an extremely simple game

reviews.title: New update is HORRIBLE
reviews.text: This new update is honestly diabolical. Give us the old, easy-to-maneuver layout back!

reviews.title: Bad Update
reviews.text: I liked the previous version. New version doesn’t work well on iPhone. Clues go away when you scroll on the Quick Cross. Makes game frustrating.

reviews.title: This update is no good
reviews.text: Please just let me have the old app back. The move forward to next clue doesn’t work and the puzzle moves up and down with annoying see through space that shows behind in neon. It’s terrible!

reviews.title: The new design is awful :(
reviews.text: The old standalone crossword experience was amazing. The new redesign/unification is horrible. Completely unusable. I hope your product team considers reverting back.

reviews.title: New crossword layout is abysmal
reviews.text: The new layout is absolutely abysmal. The crossword is now crammed into a tiny portion of the screen, with huge amounts of wasted space and unnecessary content surrounding it. The old interface was clean, simple, and let the puzzle take center stage. This redesign makes the game harder to enjoy and feels like a major step backward. Please give users the option to use the old layout or at least a true full-screen mode. This update took something that worked well and made it significantly worse.

reviews.title: New update sucks
reviews.text: I do the crossword almost everyday on my way to work and today my morning is ruined. There is too much going on with the new update. I have to scroll for the whole puzzle and the next clue button is at the top??? Ugh. Please bring back old version or at least give us the option to pick between the two.

reviews.title: Update
reviews.text: The changes that were just made to the crossword make it infuriating to use. I have to scroll up and down to read the clues for anything on the bottom half of the crossword. The way it worked before was fine. I’ve completed over 200 of the USA Today crosswords. I wont be doing this crossword going forward with how it works now.

reviews.title: Changes
reviews.text: Recent updates are awful. The functionality is incredibly clunky and poorly designed.

reviews.title: Update is horrible
reviews.text: I loved it but the “new, sleek, updated design” is clunky and not clean or sleek at all! It reminds me of 90s websites where everything was overwhelming and gaudy. The crossword - the main reason for this app- which I used to do every day- is ruined! You can’t even see the bottom tiles and clue at the same time, and it went from a nice sleek design to a bold horrible design. Honestly I’m so disappointed… I tried playing it anyway and it’s just clunky and junky now. I wish there was a way to undo the update.
